notes:
# Blackline 0.15.120

* Remote control: the Ask pill and the control strip appear the moment the offer or the session changes (they waited for an unrelated redraw); a refused pointer lock in the call window no longer throws — control works from the movement either way, and your own cursor hides over their screen.
* Screen share: frames are encoded on three threads beside the capture instead of on it, and paced against a due time rather than the last frame — measured on a 1080p screen: 30 asked for now gives 30 (was 21), 60 gives 54 (was 34).
* Screen share on the wire: H.264 first (the codec with hardware behind it on Windows), the frame rate you chose held, and a bitrate that grows with the picture — 1080p60 gets 15 Mb/s, 1080p30 10, 720p 6 (it was capped at 8 whatever the size).
* Gate: test/e2e-control.mjs walks the whole remote-control flow in the interface, including the popped-out call window.
